data/1/entries/8/entries/3/entries/4/ent.english: This room is furnished in the same fashion as area D3, with the additional feature of a secret door in the north wall. A character who searches the north wall and succeeds on a {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check finds the secret door, which swings inward when pushed. A foul, sewer-like stench greets anyone who opens the secret door. Behind the door, a staircase descends 20 feet to {@adventure area D5|BGDIA|1|D5. Welcome to the Dungeon}, featuring smooth stone steps and brick walls. Two sputtering torches in wall sconces illuminate the staircase, but the dungeon below is dark.
data/1/entries/8/entries/3/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: 這個房間的陳設與區域 D3 相同，北牆另外設有一扇密門。搜尋北牆並成功通過 {@dc 10} 感知（{@skill Perception}）檢定的角色會發現密門；推門時，它會向內開啟。任何打開密門的人都會聞到一股下水道般的惡臭。門後的樓梯沿著光滑的石階與磚牆向下延伸 20 尺，通往{@adventure 區域 D5|BGDIA|1|D5. Welcome to the Dungeon}。牆上兩支噼啪作響的火把照亮了樓梯，下方的地城卻一片漆黑。
data/1/entries/8/entries/3/entries/4/ent.reviewReason: 依英文核對語境、數值與完整性

data/1/entries/8/entries/3/entries/15/en.english: The flooded, rubble-strewn tunnels leading to and from this room narrow to a width of 2½ feet in places. Four rotting wooden beams rise from the murky water to brace the ceiling here. Rubble piled in the northwest corner contains nothing of interest.
data/1/entries/8/entries/3/entries/15/en.zh_tw: 通往這個房間的隧道積滿污水、散落碎石，部分位置窄至 2½ 尺。四根腐朽的木樑從混濁水中豎起，支撐著天花板。西北角的碎石堆裡沒有值得留意的東西。
data/1/entries/8/entries/3/entries/15/en.reviewReason: 依英文核對語境、數值與完整性

data/1/entries/7/entries/1.english: Zodge has spies who keep him informed on the characters' progress. If the characters don't visit Elfsong Tavern within forty-eight hours of receiving their orders, Zodge sends a squad of six Flaming Fist {@creature Veteran||veterans} and one {@creature flameskull} to escort the characters to the tavern, kill anyone who refuses to go, and report back to him. If the characters destroy or escape this squad, Zodge mobilizes two more squads to hunt them down.
data/1/entries/7/entries/1.zh_tw: 佐迪有耳目會隨時向他彙報角色們的進展。如果角色們在收到命令後的48小時內不去拜訪精靈之歌酒館的話，佐迪會派遣一支由六名焰拳{@creature Veteran||老兵}和一隻{@creature flameskull||燃焰之顱}組成的小隊去將他們護送前往精靈之歌酒館，殺掉那些不願意前往酒館的人，並隨後向他報告。如果角色們消滅或逃離了這支小隊，佐迪會再派遣兩個小隊去獵殺他們。
data/1/entries/7/entries/1.reviewReason: progress 指行動進度，非程式

data/1/entries/10/entries/5/entries/9/en.english: Thalamra Vanthampur and her sons gather here once a tenday for an always-tense family dinner. Read the following when the characters can see this area:
data/1/entries/10/entries/5/entries/9/en.zh_tw: 薩納姆娜·范薩普爾和她的兒子們每隔 10 天會聚在這裡進行一次氣氛總是很緊張的家庭晚宴，當角色抵達該區域時做出以下描述：

data/1/entries/10/entries/5/entries/10/e.english: A 6-foot-tall wax statue in one corner depicts {@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA} cradling the family pet, Slobberchops, in her arms. The {@creature tressym|BGDIA} has a wax rat in its mouth. Visitors who enter the gallery from the foyer ({@area area V3|09f|x}) are often startled by the statue because of its location just inside the door and its lifelike appearance.
data/1/entries/10/entries/5/entries/10/e.zh_tw: 角落裡擺著一尊 6 尺高的蠟像，造型是{@creature Duke Thalamra Vanthampur|BGDIA|薩納姆娜·范薩普爾公爵}抱著家庭寵物"嘴裡流涎"的蠟像，{@creature tressym|BGDIA|翼貓}嘴裡還叼著一隻蠟製老鼠。從前廳（{@area 區域V3|09f|x}）進入陳列室的客人通常都會被嚇一跳，因為蠟像就放在門後而又那麼逼真。
data/1/entries/10/entries/5/entries/10/e.reviewReason: 補回蠟像高度並修正量詞

data/1/entries/14/entries/6/entries/7/en.english: More information about how to use the poster map can be found in {@area chapter 3|1b0|x}.
data/1/entries/14/entries/6/entries/7/en.zh_tw: 關於如何使用這張海報地圖，詳見{@area 第3章|1b0|x}。
data/1/entries/14/entries/6/entries/7/en.reviewReason: 依英文核對語境、數值與完整性

data/2/entries/7/entries/8/entries/4/ent.english: With a successful {@dc 10} Intelligence ({@skill History}) check, a character can remember the name of one of the heroes represented by the carved pillars, with another name remembered for each point by which the check total exceeds 10. The names of the heroes are Agnithar, Zokel of Torm, Bertra Zomes, Yevina Druen, Ca'sar, Xivik Looren, Dopp Hoosser, Whrenk the Bloody, Laveil deNue, and VanLancer Eagletalon.
data/2/entries/7/entries/8/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: 透過成功的{@dc 10} 智力（{@skill History||歷史}）檢定，角色可以回憶起雕刻在柱子上的英雄之一的名字，檢定總值每超過 10 一點，就能多記起一個名字。英雄的名字分別是艾格尼薩，託爾姆·索克，貝爾特拉·佐姆斯，葉維娜·德魯恩，卡薩爾，希維克·洛倫，多普·霍瑟，血腥的沃林科，拉韋爾·德努埃和範蘭瑟·埃格爾塔隆。
data/2/entries/7/entries/8/entries/4/ent.reviewReason: 補回額外回憶姓名的門檻

data/4/entries/4/entries/7/entries/0.english: If the characters are traveling with the ice imp (see "{@area Mirror of Mephistar|208|x}"), it leads them to the narrowest point of the Styx's tributary river and sets about hammering its five shattersticks into the rocky ravine walls (see the "{@area Shatterstick|20c|x}" sidebar). The imp asks the characters to stand guard while it works. As the imp places the shattersticks, eight {@creature Spined Devil||spined devils} swoop down and attack. One minute after the last shatterstick is activated, the combined seismic activity of all the shattersticks triggers a huge rockfall that fills the gully, creating a dam.
data/4/entries/4/entries/7/entries/0.zh_tw: 如果角色和冰小魔鬼（參見"{@area 梅菲斯特之鏡|208|x}"）一起旅行，它會把他們帶到冥河支流最狹窄的地方，並開始將它的五根粉碎棒錘入溝壑的巖壁（參見"{@area 粉碎棒|20c|x}"邊欄）。小魔鬼讓角色們在它工作的時候站崗。當小魔鬼設定碎石棒時，八個{@creature Spined Devil||棘魔}會俯衝下來攻擊。在最後一根碎石棒被啟用一分鐘後，所有碎石棒的引起的地震聯動引發了巨大的山崩，填滿了河谷，形成了一座大壩。
data/4/entries/4/entries/7/entries/0.reviewReason: 不加入目前英文來源沒有的頁碼

data/7/entries/6/entries/4/entries/2/ent.english: A chorus of screams rises up as people, sheep, and pigs scamper through the town, chased by a demon with the lower body of a great serpent and the upper body of a six-armed gnoll clutching a wicked sword in each of its clawed hands.
data/7/entries/6/entries/4/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 人們、羊群和豬隻在鎮上四處奔逃，尖叫聲此起彼落。一頭惡魔正在追趕他們：牠的下半身是巨蛇，上半身則是六臂豺狼人，每隻爪手都緊握著一把凶惡的劍。
data/7/entries/6/entries/4/entries/2/ent.reviewReason: 修復被另一事件指示覆蓋的朗讀框

data/7/entries/7/entries/6/entries/0.english: The characters should be at least 13th level before heading into {@adventure chapter 5|BGDIA|8} of the adventure.
data/7/entries/7/entries/6/entries/0.zh_tw: 角色在進入本冒險的{@adventure 第5章|BGDIA|8}之前，應至少達到 13 級。
data/7/entries/7/entries/6/entries/0.reviewReason: 依英文核對語境、數值與完整性

data/0/entries/4/entries/5/entries/2.english: {@b Patience}. Devils are rarely in a rush to make a deal or sign a contract. As masters of the long con, devils make genuinely good deals with mortals to buy appreciation and trust that can be leveraged during more consequential dealings later on.
data/0/entries/4/entries/5/entries/2.zh_tw: {@b 耐心}。魔鬼很少急著達成交易或簽訂契約。牠們擅長長期布局的騙局，會先與凡人做出確實有利的交易，贏得對方的感激與信任，再於日後更重大的交易中利用這些關係。
data/0/entries/4/entries/5/entries/2.reviewReason: long con 指長期騙局，非長線交易

data/1/entries/8/entries/3/entries/13/en.english: The necromancer looming over the corpse is Flennis, a female human {@creature master of souls|BGDIA} and the highest-ranking follower of Myrkul in the dungeon. Use the {@creature swarm of rats} stat block in the {@book Monster Manual|MM} to represent Flennis' {@creature skeletal rats|BGDIA}, which are undead instead of beasts. The swarm can be turned by any character with the Turn Undead feature, but spells that target beasts have no effect on it.
data/1/entries/8/entries/3/entries/13/en.zh_tw: 這個一直在研究屍體的死靈法師叫福尼斯，她是一個人類女性{@creature master of souls|BGDIA|馭魂者}，她同時是這個地城裡最高等階的米爾寇信徒。對於福尼斯的{@creature skeletal rats|BGDIA|骷髏鼠}採用{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中的{@creature swarm of rats||鼠群}資料面板，但將野獸詞條替換成不死生物。任何具有驅散不死生物能力的角色都能驅散這群骷髏鼠，但是任何目標為野獸的法術無法在它們身上生效。
data/1/entries/8/entries/3/entries/13/en.reviewReason: Turn Undead 不是淨化或必然摧毀

data/1/entries/8/entries/5/entries/2/ent.english: A {@creature black gauntlet of Bane|BGDIA} comes after the characters with two {@creature Reaper of Bhaal|BGDIA|reapers of Bhaal} and a {@creature master of souls|BGDIA}, who commands an undead force of six {@creature Skeleton||skeletons} or four {@creature Zombie||zombies}.
data/1/entries/8/entries/5/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 一個{@creature black gauntlet of Bane|BGDIA|班恩之黑手}和兩名{@creature Reaper of Bhaal|BGDIA|巴爾的收割者}會尾隨著角色們，還有一名指揮著六個{@creature Skeleton||骷髏}或四個{@creature Zombie||喪屍}的{@creature master of souls|BGDIA|馭魂者}。
data/1/entries/8/entries/5/entries/2/ent.reviewReason: or 選擇關係不得翻成累加

data/1/entries/10/entries/4/entries/2/en.english: Sarvinder Peck, a salty fifty-two-year-old groundskeeper and stable master
data/1/entries/10/entries/4/entries/2/en.zh_tw: 沙文德·佩克，52 歲、說話粗獷的園丁兼馬廄主管
data/1/entries/10/entries/4/entries/2/en.reviewReason: stable master 是職務；salty 不是幽默

data/9/entries/12/entries/13/entries/17/.english: High Constable and Master of Walls Osmurl Havanack, a lawful neutral male shield dwarf {@creature veteran} with a deep loyalty to his constables and no taste for city politics, functions as the Watch Citadel's castellan. Havanack ensures that the Citadel is provisioned, that pay is correctly disbursed by the purse master, and that the Citadel and Old Wall are properly maintained. He also disciplines Watch soldiers accused of misdeeds—accusations that he takes very seriously and does his best to investigate. High Constable Havanack is known to have no tolerance for misconduct in his ranks, but he is only one person, and much escapes his notice.
data/9/entries/12/entries/13/entries/17/.zh_tw: 警備總長兼城牆主管奧斯穆爾·哈瓦納克，一個守序中立的男性盾矮人{@creature veteran||老兵}，對下屬忠誠深厚，對城市政治毫無興趣，擔任守望堡壘的總管。哈瓦納克確保堡壘得到供應，由財務主管正確發放薪酬，並確保堡壘和老城牆得到適當維護。他還負責懲處被指控有不當行為的守望士兵——他非常認真對待這些指控，並盡力調查。眾所周知，警備總長哈瓦納克對他的隊伍中的不當行為零容忍，但他只是一個人，很多事都逃過了他的注意。
data/9/entries/12/entries/13/entries/17/.reviewReason: Master of Walls 指城牆管理職務

data/9/entries/12/entries/13/entries/8/e.english: This vast workshop is the center of Gond's religion in Baldur's Gate. Every day, the anvils and worktables that fill the High House of Wonders ring with the clamor of hammer and saw. Under the scrutiny of the meticulous High Artificer Andar Beech, a neutral male human {@creature priest}, inventors work alongside priests and acolytes beside masters of all disciplines. Because the creations in these workshops are largely experimental prototypes, they are not deemed fit for public view.
data/9/entries/12/entries/13/entries/8/e.zh_tw: 這座龐大的工坊是博德之門的貢德信仰中心。奇蹟高殿裡擺滿鐵砧與工作臺，每天都迴盪著敲錘和鋸切的聲響。中立陣營的人類男性{@creature priest}、首席奇械師安達爾·比奇一絲不苟地監督著這裡；發明家與祭司、侍僧及各領域的大師並肩工作。工坊裡的造物多半是實驗原型，因此不適合向公眾展示。
data/9/entries/12/entries/13/entries/8/e.reviewReason: artificer 不是術士；保留技藝大師的正確義項

data/6/entries/3.english: {@b Styx Watchtower}. One of several fortifications along the River Styx used by devils to guard against invasion.
data/6/entries/3.zh_tw: {@b 冥河瞭望塔}。 冥河周圍一系列的工事之一，魔鬼用來防備入侵的建築。
data/6/entries/3.reviewReason: 逐段核對 devil／archdevil 語境；保留魔鬼與惡魔的種族區別

data/6/entries/7/entries/9/entries/0.english: Engine oil covers this horned devil, which constantly chews on a shard of smoking, red hot coal. Bazelsteen is more interested in machines than creatures and is willing to repair or modify any infernal war machine that the characters currently use. See {@adventure appendix B|BGDIA|11} for possible weapon replacements, armor upgrades, and magic gadgetry. Instead of payment, the horned devil requires that they help it complete a test (see "Test Run 221" below). If the characters perform this task well, Bazelsteen agrees to fully repair their infernal war machines. He also offers one free weapon swap, armor upgrade, or magical gadget.
data/6/entries/7/entries/9/entries/0.zh_tw: 這個有角的魔鬼身上沾滿了引擎油，它不斷地咀嚼著一塊冒煙的、熾熱的煤塊。Bazelsteen對機器比對生物更感興趣，願意修理或改造角色們當前使用的任何地獄戰爭機器。見{@adventure 附錄 B|BGDIA|11}以瞭解可能的武器替換、盔甲升級和魔法裝置。作為支付，這個有角的魔鬼要求他們幫助它完成一個測試（見下文的"測試執行221"）。如果角色們很好地執行這項任務，Bazelsteen同意完全修理他們的地獄戰爭機器。他還提供一個免費的武器交換、盔甲升級或魔法裝置。
data/6/entries/7/entries/9/entries/0.reviewReason: 逐段核對 devil／archdevil 語境；保留魔鬼與惡魔的種族區別

data/6/entries/7/entries/9/entries/1/ent.english: Bazelsteen built the experimental bathysphere to dredge the bottom of the River Styx for silted souls. He needs to test it, but he's unwilling to risk his devils. Bazelsteen's bathysphere is a Large object that can fit up to four Medium creatures inside it. The hatch is located in the bathysphere's upper hemisphere. Bazelsteen assures the characters that the device is airtight and watertight.
data/6/entries/7/entries/9/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: Bazelsteen建造了這個實驗性的潛水球，用來從冥河的河底挖掘沉積的靈魂。他需要測試它，但他不願意拿他的魔鬼冒險。Bazelsteen的潛水球是一個大型物體，可以容納多達四個中型生物在裡面。艙口位於潛水球的上半球。Bazelsteen向角色們保證這個裝置是密封且防水的。
data/6/entries/7/entries/9/entries/1/ent.reviewReason: 逐段核對 devil／archdevil 語境；保留魔鬼與惡魔的種族區別

data/6/entries/8/entries/3/entries/1.english: {@b Garrison}. Unless it has been abandoned, the tower is staffed by an {@creature amnizu|MTF} commander, a {@creature chain devil} subcommander, ten {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils} (each one with a {@creature hell hound} on the end of a short chain), and two {@creature Spined Devil||spined devils} (see "{@area Watchtower Locations|28e|x}" for how these devils are deployed).
data/6/entries/8/entries/3/entries/1.zh_tw: {@b 駐軍}。除非已被廢棄，否則塔樓由一位{@creature amnizu|MTF|安祖魔}指揮官，一位{@creature chain devil||鏈魔}副指揮官，十位{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}（每位都牽著一隻短鏈上的{@creature hell hound||地獄獵犬}）以及兩位{@creature Spined Devil||棘魔}駐守（見"{@area 瞭望塔地區|28e|x}"瞭解這些魔鬼的部署方式）。
data/6/entries/8/entries/3/entries/1.reviewReason: 逐段核對 devil／archdevil 語境；保留魔鬼與惡魔的種族區別

data/6/entries/8/entries/3/entries/2.english: {@b Bugles}. Each devil on watch duty is issued an iron bugle. Blowing the bugle is a bonus action that blasts a hideous drone audible within 300 feet.
data/6/entries/8/entries/3/entries/2.zh_tw: {@b 號角}。每個值班的魔鬼都會得到一個鐵製號角。吹響號角是一個附贈動作，會發出一個在300尺內可聽到的可怕嗡嗡聲。
data/6/entries/8/entries/3/entries/2.reviewReason: 逐段核對 devil／archdevil 語境；保留魔鬼與惡魔的種族區別

data/6/entries/8/entries/4/entries/1/ent.english: This level of the tower is drab and unadorned save for a plain, rectangular stone table set with a pair of stone benches. Spare polearms and scale armor, suitable for five Large and ten Medium devils, are stored in racks along the walls.
data/6/entries/8/entries/4/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 這座塔的這一層非常單調且沒有裝飾，除了一張普通的長方形石桌和一對石凳。適合五個大型和十個中型魔鬼的備用長柄武器和鱗甲存放在牆邊的架子上。
data/6/entries/8/entries/4/entries/1/ent.reviewReason: 逐段核對 devil／archdevil 語境；保留魔鬼與惡魔的種族區別

data/6/entries/8/entries/4/entries/2/ent.english: The devils like to chain prisoners to the walls and use the spiked chair for interrogations. The chain devil can use its Animate Chains ability to animate the chains.
data/6/entries/8/entries/4/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 魔鬼們喜歡將囚犯鎖在牆上，並使用帶刺的椅子進行審訊。鏈魔可以利用其活化鎖鏈的能力來啟用這些鏈條。
data/6/entries/8/entries/4/entries/2/ent.reviewReason: 對照英文校正職務、能力、種族或親屬語义

data/6/entries/9/entries/6/entries/1.english: Zartar believes that the sundered chain can bestow great strength upon any chain devil that stands atop it while chanting prayers to Asmodeus. The chain devil is guarded by two {@creature Bearded Devil||bearded devils}, Narg and Yangor. If the characters make any noise near Zartar, they disturb the chain devil's concentration, causing all three devils to attack with fury.
data/6/entries/9/entries/6/entries/1.zh_tw: Zartar相信，斷裂的鏈條可以賦予任何站在其上並唸誦向阿斯蒙蒂斯祈禱的鏈魔巨大的力量。這個鏈魔由兩個{@creature Bearded Devil||須魔}，Narg和Yangor守護。如果角色們在Zartar附近發出任何噪音，他們會擾亂鏈魔的專注力，導致這三個魔鬼憤怒地攻擊。
data/6/entries/9/entries/6/entries/1.reviewReason: 逐段核對 devil／archdevil 語境；保留魔鬼與惡魔的種族區別

data/6/entries/11/entries/7/entries/0.english: If the characters killed {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} in {@adventure chapter 1|BGDIA|1}, his soul ends up in the Nine Hells, where it emerges from the River Styx as a lemure. Zariel instantly becomes aware of Thavius's fate and retrieves him. After promoting Thavius to an amnizu devil for his faithful service, Zariel confines him until Elturel's destruction. The characters find Thavius trapped in a cell aboard Zariel's flying fortress, feeling sorry for himself.
data/6/entries/11/entries/7/entries/0.zh_tw: 如果角色們在{@adventure 第一章|BGDIA|1}中殺死了{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}，他的靈魂最終會到達九層地獄，從冥河中以劣魔的形式出現。扎瑞爾立刻意識到Thavius的命運並將他救出。在提升Thavius為安祖魔魔鬼以表彰他的忠誠服務後，扎瑞爾將他關押起來，直到艾爾托瑞爾的毀滅。角色們在扎瑞爾的飛行堡壘上的一個牢房中找到了自怨自艾的Thavius。

data/6/entries/11/entries/7/entries/2/en.english: Through the bars of a cell, you see a sobbing figure huddled in the shadows. It appears to be a paunchy devil with small wings and horns, bound by shackles to the far wall. The walls of his cell are covered with blasphemous runes that glow with an infernal red light.
data/6/entries/11/entries/7/entries/2/en.zh_tw: 透過牢房的柵欄，你看到一個蜷縮在陰影中的哭泣身影。它看起來是一個有小翅膀和角的大腹便便的魔鬼，被鐐銬鎖在遠處的牆上。他的牢房牆壁上覆蓋著發光的地獄紅色褻瀆符文。

data/6/entries/11/entries/7/entries/4.english: The pitiable figure in the cell is {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}, now an {@creature amnizu|MTF}. If the characters met Thavius when he was human, they recognize him in his devil form with a successful {@dc 10} Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) check. The locked cell door can be forced open with a successful {@dc 25} Strength ({@skill Athletics}) check, or a character can use {@item thieves' tools|phb} to try to pick its lock, doing so with a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check.
data/6/entries/11/entries/7/entries/4.zh_tw: 牢房中的可憐身影是{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}，現在已變為{@creature amnizu|MTF|安祖魔}。如果角色們在薩維烏斯還是人類時見過他，他們可以透過一次成功的{@dc 10}感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定認出他的魔鬼形態。牢房的門可以透過一次成功的{@dc 25}力量（{@skill Athletics||運動}）檢定強行開啟，或者角色可以使用{@item thieves' tools|phb|盜賊工具}嘗試撬鎖，成功的{@dc 20}敏捷檢定即可實現。

data/6/entries/11/entries/7/entries/6.zh_tw: 一旦艾爾托瑞爾被拉入冥河，塔維烏斯認為扎瑞爾會放他自由，但在那之前，他寧願沉浸在自憐中。他沒想到這麼快就到了九層地獄。有關如何扮演魔鬼塔維烏斯的更多資訊，請參閱{@adventure 第五章|BGDIA|8}。

Characters who enter the chamber are susceptible to the chasmes' Drone trait. The chasmes cease their torture of Alazub to attack intruders.
data/7/entries/4/entries/3/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 被鎖住的邪魔名叫阿拉祖布，是一隻僅剩25點生命值的{@creature barbed devil||蝟魔}。三隻巨蠅是{@creature Chasme||喀嘶魔}。進入房間的角色會受到喀嘶魔「嗡鳴」特性的影響。牠們會停止折磨阿拉祖布，轉而攻擊入侵者。

data/7/entries/4/entries/3/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 束縛阿拉祖布的兩條鎖鏈將這個帶刺魔鬼懸掛在離地面25尺的高空。每條鎖鏈具有AC 19，15點生命值，並且對寒冷、火焰、毒素和心靈傷害免疫。

data/7/entries/4/entries/3/entries/6/ent.english: If the characters refuse to free Alazub, the barbed devil tries to make a deal. It can offer the information it knows or anything else within its power in exchange for freedom. If {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} is with the characters, she urges the characters not to make any deals with the devil and grows despondent if her advice is ignored. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} refuses to do anything but the bare minimum to help the characters until her confidence in their good judgment is restored.
data/7/entries/4/entries/3/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 如果角色們拒絕釋放阿拉祖布，這個帶刺魔鬼會試圖達成交易。它可以提供它所知道的情報或其能力範圍內的任何東西以換取自由。如果{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}與角色們在一起，她會敦促角色們不要與魔鬼達成任何交易，並且如果她的意見被忽視，她會變得沮喪。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}拒絕做任何超出最低限度的事情來幫助角色們，直到她對他們良好判斷力的信心得到恢復。

data/8/entries/5/entries/1/entries/0.english: In this outcome, the adventurers entreat the archdevil to redeem her angelic soul and take up her celestial mantle once more. Even though Zariel has fallen, there remains a faint glimmer of hope for her salvation. A fragment of the devil's former self still lingers within her sword, but inspiring Zariel to reverse the course of her destiny is not as easy as simply handing her the blade.
data/8/entries/5/entries/1/entries/0.zh_tw: 在這個結局中，冒險者們懇求魔鬼大公贖回她的天使靈魂，並再次承擔起她的天界使命。儘管薩瑞爾已經墮落，但對她的救贖仍然有一絲希望。魔鬼過去的自我片段仍然殘留在她的劍中，但激勵薩瑞爾逆轉她命運的軌跡並不僅僅是簡單地把劍交給她。

data/8/entries/5/entries/1/entries/2/ent.english: The archdevil's words hang in the air for a silent moment, and she glances upward in agonized uncertainty. Then Zariel is bathed in a brilliant wash of radiant light. Her fiery halo disappears, and feathers burst from her leathery wings. All of her diabolical features vanish as her angelic form is restored. At the sight of this blessed transformation, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} gasps in delight—and transforms into a celestial mammoth with golden fur, feathered wings, and gleaming tusks.
data/8/entries/5/entries/1/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 魔鬼大公的話音落下，四周靜默片刻。她痛苦而猶疑地仰望上方，隨即沐浴在璀璨的光耀之中。扎瑞爾燃燒的光環消失，皮膜雙翼迸生羽毛；所有魔鬼特徵都隨著天使形體的復原而褪去。目睹這受祝福的轉變，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}欣喜地倒抽一口氣，化為一頭擁有金色皮毛、羽翼與閃亮長牙的天界猛獁象。

data/8/entries/5/entries/3/entries/1/ent.english: Characters who die in Zariel's service are reborn as {@creature Lemure||lemures} from the River Styx. They lose all memories of their previous lives, and their alignment changes to lawful evil. If a character pleased Zariel with their loyalty in life, she might allow them to keep their memories as she promotes them to an NPC devil of your determination.

data/8/entries/5/entries/4/entries/0.english: If Zariel is redeemed or killed, the first layer of the Nine Hells falls into chaos. You can decide which of the many powerful figures in Avernus make a play to replace Zariel, but any new ruler immediately faces enemies on all sides. The invading armies of Baphomet and Yeenoghu are wreaking havoc and threatening to tear Avernus apart. Moreover, dozens of ambitious greater devils will gleefully try to supplant their new and untested ruler.
data/8/entries/5/entries/4/entries/0.zh_tw: 如果扎瑞爾得到救贖或被殺死，九層地獄的第一層將陷入混亂。您可以決定阿弗納斯眾多強大人物中哪一個試圖取代扎瑞爾，但任何新統治者立即面臨來自四面八方的敵人。巴菲米特和耶諾格的入侵軍隊正在製造混亂，威脅著要將阿弗納斯撕裂。此外，數十個雄心勃勃的更強大的魔鬼將高興地試圖取代他們新的和未經考驗的統治者。

data/8/entries/5/entries/4/entries/1.english: Ruling a layer of the Nine Hells as a mortal is effectively impossible. None of the devils of Avernus will knowingly serve anyone but a superior devil. However, Asmodeus admires ambition. The Lord of the Nine Hells might see a brash and powerful mortal as a worthy replacement for Zariel, offering to transform the character into an NPC archdevil that can rule Avernus. Alternatively, the characters might attempt to claim Avernus on their own terms.
data/8/entries/5/entries/4/entries/1.zh_tw: 作為一個凡人統治九層地獄的一個層面實際上是不可能做到的。阿弗納斯的魔鬼們不會知情地為任何不是高階魔鬼的人服務。然而，阿斯蒙蒂斯欣賞雄心壯志。九層地獄之主可能會看到一個魯莽而強大的凡人作為薩瑞爾的合適替代者，提出將角色轉變成一個能夠統治阿弗納斯的NPC魔鬼大公。或者，角色們可能會嘗試按照他們自己的條件來宣稱阿弗納斯。

From within the shield, the pit fiend Gargauth begs and sobs and promises the world to the characters if they spare its life and find a way to restore the devil to its former glory. These are empty promises, though Gargauth's fear is real.

data/9/entries/13/entries/5/entries/15/e.english: In truth, Mandorcai gained occult knowledge and his magical manor in a bargain with the obese twin {@creature Chain Devil||chain devils} Kyrix and Valisog. For years Mandorcai upheld his side of the contract by bringing the fiends mortal sacrifices, until an accidental breach of contract let the devils haul him screaming into the Nine Hells. Since then, the mansion's hungry traps and shape-changing powers have lain dormant. Recently, however, a group of {@creature Cultist||cultists} have broken into the house, seeking to harness its fell powers. Though they haven't yet figured out how to commune with the chain devils yet, when they do, it'll likely be without the safeguards Mandorcai managed to negotiate, potentially resulting in fiendish disaster for the whole neighborhood.

data/10/entries/4/entries/0.english: Despite their thirst for trapping mortal souls in binding contracts, devils can enter into deals only in specific circumstances. The easiest way for a devil to forge a deal is to do so within the Nine Hells, where it's closer to the infernal hierarchy and can more easily channel its power. Elsewhere in the multiverse, most devils are too removed from their power structure to enter into binding deals without some extraordinary circumstances.
data/10/entries/4/entries/0.zh_tw: 儘管魔鬼渴望將凡人的靈魂困在具有約束力的合同中，但它們只能在特定情況下進入交易。魔鬼最容易達成交易的方式是在九層地獄之內，那裡更接近地獄層級體系，可以更容易地引導其力量。在多元宇宙的其他地區，大多數魔鬼由於遠離其力量結構，無法在沒有一些特殊情況下進入具有約束力的交易。

data/10/entries/5/entries/0.english: Diabolical deals start with either the devil or the character broaching the subject and offering something. The terms of the deal require, at a minimum, the devil to offer a gift and the character to agree to a price. If the terms aren't acceptable to either party, they can negotiate and try to sweeten the deal by offering more valuable terms, or simply walk away. Not every deal is meant to be.
data/10/entries/5/entries/0.zh_tw: 魔鬼交易始於魔鬼或角色提出話題並提供某些東西。交易的條款至少要求魔鬼提供一個禮物，角色同意一個價格。如果條款對任何一方不可接受，他們可以協商並嘗試透過提供更有價值條款來使交易更有吸引力，或者簡單地走開。並非每個交易都註定要達成。

data/10/entries/5/entries/3/entries/0.english: Most deals with devils can be resolved without rolling dice to determine the outcome. A Charisma check can't deceive or persuade most devils into a bad deal because the fiends are too clever and experienced in deal-making to be fooled. If the wretch dies, the contract is void.

data/1/entries/15/entries/9/entries/2/en.english: When defeat on Avernus appeared inevitable, Zariel entrusted her sword to Yael, her most loyal general, and ordered {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} to help Yael find a way to hide the weapon. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} and Yael blundered into a mob of demons led by the demon lord Yeenoghu, but narrowly escaped. Yeenoghu's pet—an enormous demon named {@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA}—chased Yael and {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} across Avernus. Before it could devour them, Yael plunged Zariel's holy blade into a stone as {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} poured every ounce of her celestial being into it. A fortress sprang up around the sword, hedging out all evil. The effort so taxed {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} that she became disoriented and flew away, leaving Yael behind.
data/1/entries/15/entries/9/entries/2/en.zh_tw: 當敗局已定之後，扎瑞爾將她的劍交給了她最忠誠的將軍，耶爾。並且命令{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}幫助耶爾將劍藏匿起來。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和耶爾雖然不慎進入了由耶諾古帶領著的一批惡魔的包圍中，但他們僥倖得以逃生。但是耶諾古的寵物——一個名叫{@creature Crokek'toeck|BGDIA|克魯科克'託伊克}的兇惡惡魔在阿弗納斯中一直追逐著{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和耶爾。在他抓住他們兩人之前，耶爾將扎瑞爾的聖劍猛然插入一塊石頭中，同時{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}將自己的每一分天界本源灌入這塊石頭。一座要塞圍繞聖劍產生，將所有邪敵阻擋在外。但是{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}使用了太多的力量令她疲憊不堪，以至於她迷失方向並且飛離了，將耶爾留在了那裡。

data/9/entries/10/entries/3/entries/3.english: Most murders in the Lower City have reasons behind them. The merchant found with his throat cut and pockets emptied, the husband murdered so his wife can marry her young mistress, the tyrannical shop owner stabbed by a desperate underling—residents understand these crimes. What frightens people are the senseless murders. The man found ripped to pieces with his pockets still full of gold, the woman slaughtered so viciously that her grieving husband is sent to the asylum, the shop owner who suddenly strikes down his faithful clerk—these are the crimes that lead to panic and wild rumors.
data/9/entries/10/entries/3/entries/3.zh_tw: 下城區的大多數謀殺案背後都有原因。商人被發現喉嚨被割開，口袋被掏空；丈夫被謀殺，這樣他的妻子就可以嫁給她年輕的情婦；暴君般的店主被絕望的下屬刺傷——居民們理解這些罪行。讓人們感到恐懼的是無意義的謀殺。一個男子被發現被撕成碎片，口袋裡還裝滿了金幣；一個女子被如此殘忍地殺害，以至於她悲痛的丈夫被送進了精神病院；店主突然殺死了他忠實的店員——這些是導致恐慌和瘋狂謠言的罪行。

data/0/entries/3/entries/2/entries/0.english: Zariel lost more than her army on Avernus. She also lost a hand, which was severed in battle. As her sword fell to the ground, Zariel ordered Yael, her most devoted general, to take the weapon and hide it, so that the devils would not destroy or corrupt it. Yael took the sword and fled, along with Zariel's faithful hollyphant companion, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}. Zariel's other two generals, Olanthius and Haruman, refused to leave Zariel's side. All three were captured and sent to Nessus, the lowest of the Nine Hells. There, Zariel was brought before Asmodeus, who welcomed her with open arms. The Lord of the Nine commended Zariel for her battle prowess and the strength of her convictions. He offered her rulership of Avernus, much to {@creature Bel|BGDIA}'s chagrin. By swearing fealty to Asmodeus and the Nine Hells, Zariel could bring her rage to bear against the demons and continue to fight in the Blood War, with legions of devils under her command. Zariel accepted Asmodeus's terms, completing her fall from grace. Haruman followed his master into damnation willingly and was transformed into a narzugon devil, while Olanthius, who took his own life rather than bow before Asmodeus, was brought back to serve as a death knight under Zariel's burning gaze.
data/0/entries/3/entries/2/entries/0.zh_tw: 扎瑞爾在阿弗納斯失去的不只是軍隊；她的一隻手也在戰鬥中被斬斷。長劍落地時，她命令最忠誠的將軍耶爾帶走並藏起這件武器，免得魔鬼將它摧毀或腐化。耶爾帶著劍逃走，同行的還有扎瑞爾忠實的聖飛象夥伴{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}。另外兩位將軍奧蘭蘇斯與哈魯曼拒絕離開扎瑞爾身旁，三人於是一起被俘，押往九獄最底層的奈瑟斯。扎瑞爾被帶到阿斯蒙蒂斯面前，受到他張臂歡迎。九獄之主讚揚她的戰技與堅定信念，提出讓她統治阿弗納斯，令{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}大為惱怒。只要宣誓效忠阿斯蒙蒂斯與九獄，扎瑞爾便能指揮魔鬼軍團，在血戰中繼續向惡魔宣洩怒火。她接受條件，就此徹底墮落。哈魯曼心甘情願地追隨主人走向沉淪，化為魘騎魔；奧蘭蘇斯寧願自盡也不肯向阿斯蒙蒂斯屈膝，卻在扎瑞爾熾熱的凝視下被喚回，成為效忠她的死亡騎士。

data/9/entries/10/entries/2/entries/4.english: At the same time, worship of Bhaal proves darkly popular in Baldur's Gate. Few openly admit to worshiping the Lord of Murder, but there is an unspoken assumption that anyone who benefits from violent death has some respect for Bhaal. Assassination and murder underpin many of the plots in the city, from the business of highly-paid killers on patriar payrolls to slayings of opportunity committed by Outer City fanatics. Such bloodthirsty faithful rarely gather in numbers, but they typically mark themselves by carving a fresh gouge on their thumbs—spilling their blood in Bhaal's name while creating a subtle mark identifying that identifies them among allies. Despite the Lord of Murder's decentralized worship, some believe a temple to Bhaal exists near or under the city, possibly in an ancient chamber beneath the sewers or carved into Dusthawk Hill. Rumor holds that eleven red crystals on the wall of the temple grow brighter with every murder committed, gathering power for either Bhaal or one of his future chosen. Some claim that Bhaal himself regularly visits the temple, his presence contributing to the city's high murder rate.
data/9/entries/10/entries/2/entries/4.zh_tw: 與此同時，巴爾崇拜在博德之門暗中盛行。很少有人公開承認信奉謀殺之主，但人們心照不宣：凡是從暴力死亡中獲利的人，多少都敬畏巴爾。從貴族重金雇用的殺手，到外城狂熱信徒伺機行凶，暗殺與謀殺支撐著城中許多陰謀。這些嗜血信徒很少大批集會，通常會在拇指上劃出新傷，以巴爾之名流血，留下讓同道辨識的隱晦記號。雖然巴爾信徒各行其是，有人仍相信城內、城郊或地下藏著一座神殿，或許位於下水道下方的古老密室，或開鑿在塵鷹丘中。傳聞殿牆上的十一顆紅色水晶，每逢謀殺便更為明亮，替巴爾或他未來的某位選民積聚力量。也有人宣稱巴爾本人經常造訪，正是他的存在使城內謀殺如此頻繁。

data/9/entries/7/entries/2/entries/1.english: Crews were the first to institute the common practice of {@i burl}. Under this system, anyone seeking shelter and safety—usually those fleeing from the Flaming Fist or some other danger—can approach a house or shop and give three sharp knocks followed by a heavier one. The residents are then obligated to take that person in and hide them. This applies even to members of opposing crews, though anyone requesting sanctuary from a crew other than their own incurs a debt, both personally and on behalf of their crew. Abusing someone who's granted burl is grounds for immediate expulsion from one's crew, and such "drowners" are universally shunned.
data/9/entries/7/entries/2/entries/1.zh_tw: 街頭幫派最早訂下後來普遍通行的{@i 庇護慣例}。依照這項慣例，任何尋求安全庇護的人——通常是正在逃避焰拳或其他危險的人——都能走到民宅或商店門口，急促地敲三下，再重敲一下。屋內居民有義務收留並藏匿來人，連敵對幫派的成員也不例外。不過，向其他幫派求援的人，自己與所屬幫派都會欠下一份人情。傷害已獲庇護的人，足以讓犯事者立刻被逐出幫派；這類被稱為「溺人者」的傢伙會遭到所有人唾棄。

data/0/entries/3/entries/1.english: Zariel led her army out of Elturel amid a throng of cheering well-wishers and proud citizens in 1354 DR. Many of Zariel's warriors fought bravely, but for others, the horrors of the Nine Hells proved too great. They fled back through the portal, sealing it behind them and never revealing their shameful retreat and betrayal. The Hellriders, as they were called, would wear this badge of shame to the grave.

data/1/entries/10/entries/3/entries/2.zh_tw: 薩納姆娜已經接連喪偶三次，但她的每一任丈夫都給她留下了一個兒子。她的大兒子，瑟斯維爾，是一個40多歲，面色蒼白又沉悶的隱居者。他是一個十足的孤僻者，他用小魔鬼來監視他的兄弟們，阿姆利克和摩特洛克。瑟斯維爾憎惡他們——阿姆利克是他母親的最愛，而摩特洛克是一個醜惡笨蛋。

Another Bhaalspawn, aided by powerful allies, thwarted Sarevok's plan and brought stability, if not peace, to Baldur's Gate once more. Yet, Bhaal and his faithful have menaced the city ever since.
data/9/entries/4/entries/3/entries/1.zh_tw: 薩瑞沃克是巴爾之子，也是鐵王座商人公會的成員。他企圖挑起與安姆的戰爭，成為新的謀殺之主。另一位巴爾之子在強大盟友的協助下挫敗了他的計畫，讓博德之門再次恢復穩定，儘管未必稱得上和平。自那之後，巴爾與其信徒始終威脅著這座城市。

data/9/entries/14/entries/5/entries/16/e.english: The fortress has four levels: the bridge level, taken up by the gauntlet tunnel and offices devoted to traffic management; a second-story armory full of oil, javelins, and everything the soldiers need to withstand a siege; a third story for soldier's quarters; and a high-ceilinged dungeon level below the bridges to hold temporary prisoners and the fortress's supply of small boats (should the garrison need to sally through heavily fortified river-level gates). Soldiers stationed in the fortress tend to fall into two categories: those disappointed at being stuck on toll-collection duty so far from the city, and those overjoyed at easy work and a chance to carouse in Wyrm's Crossing, with the latter ensuring that the Fist doesn't patrol their neighboring bridges too heavily.
data/9/entries/14/entries/5/entries/16/e.zh_tw: 堡壘共有四層：橋面層設有戒備森嚴的通道與交通管理辦公室；第二層是軍械庫，備有油、標槍及士兵抵禦圍城所需的一切；第三層是兵舍；橋下另有挑高的地牢層，用來暫時關押囚犯並存放小船，好讓駐軍必要時能從河面高度、重兵防守的大門出擊。駐守士兵大致分為兩類：一類不滿自己被派到遠離城區的地方收通行費，另一類則樂於工作清閒，又能到飛龍渡暢飲作樂。後者會設法讓焰拳別把鄰近橋樑巡得太勤。

data/9/entries/13/entries/5/entries/9/en.english: Part school and part alehouse, this wide three-story building leans precariously over the street in Eastway. Run by an old, agender martial artist named Garmult (neutral good human {@creature gladiator}), the House of Mastery offers both martial training of all sorts for the city's would-be warriors and a central hangout for the Bannerless Legion crew. Garmult assists crew leader Dezri "Guts" Lamouer in matching clients with mercenaries. They also hire members to teach classes in the building's open-air atrium while other members lounge on the overlooking balconies. At any given time, there's usually multiple veteran mercenaries here swapping stories and waiting for contracts.
data/9/entries/13/entries/5/entries/9/en.zh_tw: 這棟寬敞的三層樓建築兼作武術學館與酒館，朝東道街面危險地傾斜。經營者是年邁、無性別的武術家加穆爾特（中立善良的人類{@creature gladiator||角鬥士}）。武藝館提供各式武術訓練，吸引城中有志成為戰士的人，也作為無旗軍團幫派的聚會據點。加穆爾特協助首領德茲里「腸子」拉穆爾替客戶與傭兵牽線，並雇用團員在露天中庭授課，其他人則在上方陽臺休息。任何時候通常都有幾位老練傭兵在這裡交換見聞、等待委託。
data/9/entries/13/entries/5/entries/9/en.reviewReason: school／alehouse／crew／mastery 依場景重譯，維持無性別角色設定

data/0/entries/2/entries/1/entries/2.english: With Grand Duke {@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA} out of the way, Thalamra is paying the Dead Three to shatter confidence in the Flaming Fist so that all payments to the decapitated organization can be cut off. Thalamra, a devout disciple of the archdevil Zariel, has brokered a deal that will enable her to claim the role of grand duke once the Flaming Fist disbands, paving the way for the city's descent into Avernus. To accomplish this last goal, Thalamra needs an artifact called the {@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA}, imprisoned in which is a pit fiend named Gargauth. Until recently, the shield was sealed in a tomb under the city, but Thalamra's sons recently stole it and transported it to the dungeon below their villa. So corrupt is the shield that its mere presence in Baldur's Gate has contributed to the city's moral decay for decades.
data/0/entries/2/entries/1/entries/2.zh_tw: 在大公{@creature Ulder Ravengard|BGDIA|烏爾德·瑞文嘉德}失蹤期間，薩納姆娜付錢給死亡三神教徒來破壞大家對焰拳的信任以便中止所有給這個群龍無首的組織的酬金。薩納姆娜是魔鬼大公扎瑞爾的一名虔誠信奉者，她已經談好了一筆交易：在焰拳解散，給把這個城市打入地獄掃除障礙後，扎瑞爾便能助她成為大公。為了達成這個最終的目標，薩納姆娜需要一件名為{@item Shield of the Hidden Lord|BGDIA|隱藏領主的盾牌}的神器，其內囚禁著名為加葛斯的深獄煉魔。直到不久前這面盾牌還被封印在這座城市的一座地下墓穴裡，但是薩納姆娜的兒子們最近把它偷了出來並轉移到了他們別墅下方的地城裡。這面盾牌是如此地汙穢，僅僅是存在於博德之門就造成了市民們數十年來的道德敗壞。

data/3/entries/9/entries/5/entries/2.english: For a while, L'zeth nursed its damaged pride. Eventually, the despondent devil reignited its ambitions and became involved in a plot to overthrow Zariel. The archdevil's spies learned of the plot. As further punishment, Zariel removed L'zeth's wings and cursed the horned devil so that it could no longer enter into deals. Any document that L'zeth signs melts away, and any words it utters turn to smoke in its mouth. Thus did L'zeth become known as {@creature Bitter Breath|BGDIA}.
data/3/entries/9/entries/5/entries/2.zh_tw: 有一陣子，萊澤斯默默舔舐著自己受損的驕傲。最終，沮喪的魔鬼重新點燃了野心，並參與了一場推翻扎瑞爾的陰謀。而魔鬼大公的間諜得知了這個陰謀。作為進一步的懲罰，扎瑞爾剝奪了萊澤斯的翅膀，並詛咒了這隻角魔，以至於它再也不能參與任何交易中去。萊澤斯簽名的任何檔案都會熔化，並且其說出口的任何單詞都會變成它嘴裡冒出的煙。因此，萊澤斯開始被稱為{@creature Bitter Breath|BGDIA|苦痛之息}。

Kovik aims to gather enough strength and infernal war machines to do what no archdevil has been able to do: drive the demons back to the Abyss for good.
data/3/entries/9/entries/7/entries/2.zh_tw: 那些服從於科維克領導的魔鬼之所以願意這樣，是因為這鏈魔贏得了他們的信任。那些新近被剝奪權利的魔鬼經常聚集到科維克的旗幟之下。這名鏈魔的象徵是在赤紅色場地上用鐵鏈製成的數字 8。科維克的目的是聚集足夠的力量和地獄戰爭機器來做那些魔鬼大公無法做到的事情：將惡魔永遠地驅逐回無底深淵。

data/4/entries/2/entries/8/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 解除了他的偽裝，這隻惡猿魔乞求角色們去找到墨菲斯托費勒斯並且帶回他謎題的答案。然後這隻惡猿魔會給他們指出一個魔鏡（梅菲斯特之鏡）的方向，這個魔鏡可以用來窺見卡尼亞以及和那位魔鬼大公聯絡。如果角色們成功說服了墨菲斯托費勒斯，烏巴盧克斯承諾會帶著他們找到能夠幫忙找到湧血城砦的人。

data/4/entries/3/entries/4.english: Anyone who gazes into the surface of this 20-foot-tall mirror of ice sees their reflection as soulless, haggard, and encrusted with rime. Characters who succeed on a {@dc 25} Intelligence ({@skill Arcana}) check recognize the tower as Mephistar, lair of the archdevil Mephistopheles.
data/4/entries/3/entries/4.zh_tw: 任何一個凝視著這面 20 尺高的冰鏡的人都會看到他們的倒影，那沒有靈魂、形容枯槁、覆著冰霜的倒影。這個倒影站在一片冰凍的苔原上，除了遠處的一座冰塔之外，只剩荒涼。成功透過一次{@dc 25}的智力（{@skill Arcana||奧秘}）檢定的角色可以辨別出這座塔就是魔鬼大公墨菲斯托費勒斯的巢穴。

data/4/entries/3/entries/6/entries/5/ent.english: If Mephistopheles learns of the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}, the archdevil orders the imp to follow the group invisibly after it completes its demolition work and report back when they've located the Bleeding Citadel. At that point, Mephistopheles sends an {@creature ice devil} into Avernus with orders to murder the characters and steal the sword. If he gets the sword, Mephistopheles plans to use the artifact as leverage against Zariel in future dealings.
data/4/entries/3/entries/6/entries/5/ent.zh_tw: 如果墨菲斯托費勒斯知曉了{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}的存在，這位魔鬼大公會命令小魔鬼在完成爆破工作之後隱形地跟著角色們的隊伍並且在他們到達湧血城砦時向他彙報。在那時，墨菲斯托費勒斯會將一個{@creature ice devil||冰魔}送到到達阿弗納斯，它被下了命令來殺死角色們以及偷走扎瑞爾之劍。如果他得到了扎瑞爾之劍，墨菲斯托費利斯計劃在未來的交易中使用這把神器作為對付扎瑞爾的手段。

data/6/entries/10/entries/5/entries/5/en.english: Mahadi has the power to make deals at the direction and with the authority of Asmodeus as if he were an archdevil (see {@adventure appendix A|BGDIA|10}). All such deals must be presented to the other party without alteration, and they are not negotiable. In all such agreements, Asmodeus wants one thing only: a character signing one of these contracts gives up their soul forever. After the signing character reaches 17th level, if at any point they die, their death is permanent, with no chance to return from the grave. Asmodeus takes their soul and makes them a {@creature pit fiend}, in his service for eternity.
data/6/entries/10/entries/5/entries/5/en.zh_tw: 馬哈迪擁有以阿斯蒙蒂斯的名義和許可權進行交易的力量，彷彿他是一位魔鬼大公（參見{@adventure 附錄A|BGDIA|10}）。所有這些交易都必須原封不動地呈現給對方，且不可協商。在所有此類協議中，阿斯蒙蒂斯只想要一樣東西：簽署這些合同之一的角色將永遠放棄他們的靈魂。在簽署角色達到17級後，如果在任何時候死亡，他們的死亡將是永久性的，沒有機會從墳墓中復活。阿斯蒙蒂斯將奪取他們的靈魂並將他們變成{@creature pit fiend||深獄煉魔}，永遠為他服務。

data/7/entries/7/entries/1/entries/0.english: You stand before the dais, atop which glows the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}. Also before you are {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} and the ghostly warrior, Yael. The hollyphant is the first to speak. "I remember everything now. Idyllglen was the last straw. We followed Zariel to Avernus, but the evil there proved to be too much for us. Asmodeus appeared and promised Zariel infernal legions to end the Blood War, but she had to give the Lord of the Nine Hells her fealty. She accepted and became an archdevil, but not before Yael and I took her sword, hoping it could redeem Zariel someday. I gave up my magic and memories, and Yael gave her life to construct this place to protect the sword."
data/7/entries/7/entries/1/entries/0.zh_tw: 你站在高臺前，上面放著發光的{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}。同樣在你面前的是{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}和幽靈戰士耶爾。聖飛象是第一個說話的。"我現在記起一切了。伊迪爾格倫是最後一根稻草。我們跟隨扎瑞爾到了阿弗納斯，但那裡的邪惡對我們來說太過分了。阿斯蒙蒂斯出現並向扎瑞爾承諾，給予她地獄軍團來結束血戰，但她必須向九獄之王效忠。她接受了併成為了魔鬼大公，但在此之前，耶爾和我拿走了她的劍，希望有一天能夠救贖扎瑞爾。我放棄了我的魔法和記憶，而耶爾獻出了生命來建造這個地方，以保護這把劍。"

data/8/entries/5/entries/0.english: The characters could give Zariel more power to rule Avernus, or they could support one of the archdevil's enemies in a bid to unseat her. They could also try to destroy Zariel, creating a power vacuum that throws Avernus into disarray. Whatever the outcome, the characters are poised to help write cosmic history.
data/8/entries/5/entries/0.zh_tw: 角色們可以給扎瑞爾更多的力量來統治阿弗納斯，或者他們可以支援其中一個魔鬼大公的敵人，試圖推翻她。他們也可以嘗試摧毀扎瑞爾，製造一個權力真空，使阿弗納斯陷入混亂。無論結果如何，角色們都準備幫助書寫宇宙歷史。

data/8/entries/5/entries/1/entries/1/ent.english: To redeem Zariel, the characters must possess the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}. Bringing the sword within 10 feet of Zariel causes the weapon to glow brighter, then levitate to hover before her. Confronted with the last fragment of her angelic spark, Zariel faces an internal struggle. In this moment, the characters have a chance to help the archdevil return to the light.
data/8/entries/5/entries/1/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 要救贖扎瑞爾，角色們必須擁有{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}。將劍帶到扎瑞爾10尺以內，會導致武器發光更亮，然後懸浮在她面前。面對她天使火花的最後碎片，扎瑞爾面臨內心的掙扎。在這個時刻，角色們有機會幫助魔鬼大公迴歸光明。

data/8/entries/5/entries/2/entries/2.english: Defeating Zariel is easier said than done. At her full power, the archdevil is more than a match for most mortals. Adventurers who hope to lay her low must scheme like a devil. Forging an alliance with a powerful, supernatural being such as {@creature Bel|BGDIA}, Gargauth, Tiamat, or one of the demon lords besieging Avernus could grant the characters the power necessary to cast down Zariel.
data/8/entries/5/entries/2/entries/2.zh_tw: 擊敗扎瑞爾說起來容易做起來難。在她全力施展時，這位魔鬼大公比大多數凡人都要強大。希望將她擊敗的冒險者必須像惡魔一樣策劃。與像{@creature Bel|BGDIA|貝爾}、加葛斯、提亞瑪特，或者圍攻阿弗納斯的惡魔領主等強大超自然生物結盟，可能會賦予角色們必要的力量來打倒扎瑞爾。
data/8/entries/5/entries/2/entries/2.reviewReason: 核對 archdevil 階級：魔鬼大公，非惡魔或泛稱強大魔鬼

data/8/entries/5/entries/2/entries/5/ent.english: If released, Gargauth thanks the characters through tears of mirth. The pit fiend's first act is to produce a contract out of thin air, claiming that it will aid the characters in their quest to destroy Zariel if they sign it. The contract is full of convoluted text, and is summarized in its final clause: "I, the undersigned, agree to form a compact with Gargauth, joining with it to destroy the archdevil Zariel. While bound by this compact, no intentional harm shall befall either party by the other party's hand, without voiding this agreement."
data/8/entries/5/entries/2/entries/5/ent.zh_tw: 如果被釋放，加葛斯會透過歡笑的淚水向角色們表示感謝。這個深獄煉魔的第一個行動是從空氣中拿出一份合同，聲稱如果角色們簽署它，它將幫助他們在摧毀扎瑞爾的任務中。這份合同充滿了複雜的文字，並在其最後一條中總結如下："我，簽名者，同意與加葛斯結成契約，聯合起來摧毀魔鬼大公扎瑞爾。在受此契約約束期間，除非解除此協議，否則任何一方不得故意傷害另一方。"

data/8/entries/5/entries/2/entries/6/ent.english: The queen of evil dragons is mighty and aloof, and she rarely acts unless her triumph is assured. Challenging an archdevil directly is risky, and {@creature Tiamat|RoT} stands to lose a great deal if Zariel prevails. Fortunately, Tiamat has a champion she can send in her stead: {@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA}.
data/8/entries/5/entries/2/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 邪惡龍後強大而孤傲，她很少行動，除非勝利在握。直接挑戰一位魔鬼大公是危險的，而如果扎瑞爾獲勝，{@creature Tiamat|RoT|提亞馬特}將失去許多。幸運的是，提亞馬特有一位冠軍可以代替她行動：{@creature Arkhan the Cruel|BGDIA|殘酷者阿克漢}。

data/8/entries/5/entries/2/entries/6/ent.english: Arkhan declares that he will muster an army and depose Zariel in ten days. Exactly ten days later, two hundred {@creature white abishai|MTF} fly from Arkhan's tower toward Zariel's current location, with Arkhan leading the charge on the back of Asojano the {@creature chimera}, and {@creature Torogar Steelfist|BGDIA} by his side, carried on the back of Chango the {@creature manticore}. Arkhan's army is bolstered by five chromatic dragons—one adult dragon of each color—sent by Tiamat to help ensure victory. If they so choose, the characters can join Arkhan. The abishai and the dragons engage Zariel's legions while Arkhan, Torogar, and the characters challenge the archdevil herself. This battle can play out as part of the "{@area Endgame in Elturel|340|x}" section described at the end of this chapter.
data/8/entries/5/entries/2/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 阿坎宣稱他將集結一支軍隊並在十天內廢黜扎瑞爾。確切的十天後，兩百隻{@creature white abishai|MTF|亞比莎白龍魔}從阿坎的塔樓飛向扎瑞爾的當前位置，阿坎騎在阿索亞諾這隻{@creature chimera||奇美拉}的背上領導衝鋒，而{@creature Torogar Steelfist|BGDIA|託羅加·鋼拳}在他身邊，騎在昌戈這隻{@creature manticore||刺尾獅}的背上。阿坎的軍隊得到了五隻色彩龍的加強——每種顏色的成年龍一隻——由提阿瑪特派遣來幫助確保勝利。如果他們選擇，角色們可以加入阿坎。阿比夏和龍與扎瑞爾的軍團交戰，而阿坎、託羅加和角色們挑戰這位魔鬼大公本人。這場戰鬥可以作為本章末尾描述的"{@area 艾爾托瑞爾的終局|340|x}"部分的一部分展開。

data/8/entries/5/entries/3/entries/1/ent.english: Characters who choose to serve Zariel must sign a contract (see {@adventure appendix A|BGDIA|10}) forfeiting their souls to the archdevil. She then returns such characters to the Material Plane to do her bidding. Zariel has numerous schemes spinning at any given time, but the adventurers are particularly well suited to preparing Baldur's Gate to meet the same fate as Elturel. As a sign of favor, she bestows a charm upon each character (see "{@area Archdevil Charms|414|x}").
data/8/entries/5/entries/3/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 選擇為扎瑞爾服務的角色必須簽署一份合同（見{@adventure 附錄A|BGDIA|10}），將他們的靈魂交給這位魔鬼大公。然後，她將這些角色送回物質界，以執行她的命令。扎瑞爾隨時都有無數的陰謀在進行，但冒險者們特別適合準備博德之門迎接與艾爾托瑞爾相同的命運。作為青睞的標誌，她給每個角色賜予了一個護身符（見"{@area 魔鬼大公的護咒|414|x}"）。
data/8/entries/5/entries/3/entries/1/ent.reviewReason: 核對 archdevil 階級：魔鬼大公，非惡魔或泛稱強大魔鬼

data/8/entries/5/entries/4/entries/2.english: Idealistic characters seeking to destroy the Nine Hells from the inside out might see this power vacuum as an opportunity to strike a mortal blow to Asmodeus's reign. This might be the only time in cosmic history that such a blindly idealistic cause could succeed. But even if the party can wrest Avernus from Asmodeus's control, this ultimately serves to unite the remaining archdevils, aligning them toward the common goal of reclaiming Avernus—which works to Asmodeus's advantage.
data/8/entries/5/entries/4/entries/2.zh_tw: 理想主義角色尋求從內到外摧毀九層地獄，可能會將這種權力真空視為對阿斯蒙蒂斯統治發起致命一擊的機會。這可能是宇宙歷史上唯一一次，如此盲目的理想主義事業能夠成功。但即使隊伍能夠從阿斯蒙蒂斯的控制中奪取阿弗納斯，這最終會使剩餘的魔鬼大公團結起來，朝著奪回阿弗納斯的共同目標前進——這反而對阿斯蒙蒂斯有利。

data/8/entries/6/entries/2/entries/1/ite.english: To grant the blade its power, the freshly forged weapon must be quenched in the blood of a celestial, a demon lord, and an archdevil. Zariel can supply her own blood, but her servants must collect the other two sacrifices.
data/8/entries/6/entries/2/entries/1/ite.zh_tw: 為了賦予劍力量，新鍛造的武器必須在天界的血液、惡魔領主和魔鬼大公的血液中淬火。扎瑞爾可以提供她自己的血液，但她的僕人必須收集其他兩個祭品。
data/8/entries/6/entries/2/entries/1/ite.reviewReason: 核對 archdevil 階級：魔鬼大公，非惡魔或泛稱強大魔鬼

data/8/entries/6/entries/4/entries/0.english: Voiding the infernal contract between Zariel and {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA} causes the hellish chains binding Elturel to crumble to ash. This can be accomplished by either killing Zariel or by destroying the original contract. Zariel can use an action to summon the contract, which appears in her one hand. The contract is otherwise hidden in a secret place known only to her. Getting Zariel to call forth the contract takes guile, as the archdevil can't be {@condition charmed}. Destroying the original copy of {@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA}'s contract frees Elturel while leaving Zariel's other contracts intact.
data/8/entries/6/entries/4/entries/0.zh_tw: 廢除扎瑞爾和{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}之間的地獄契約會導致束縛艾爾托瑞爾的地獄鏈條化為灰燼。這可以透過殺死扎瑞爾或摧毀原始契約來實現。扎瑞爾可以使用一個動作來召喚契約，契約會出現在她的一隻手中。契約通常隱藏在一個只有她知道的秘密地方。讓扎瑞爾召喚契約需要狡猾，因為這位魔鬼大公不能被{@condition charmed||魅惑}。摧毀{@creature Thavius Kreeg|BGDIA|塔維斯·克雷格}契約的原始副本可以釋放艾爾托瑞爾，同時保留扎瑞爾的其他契約。

data/8/entries/6/entries/5/entries/0.english: If the characters have no other options for dealing with Zariel, one or more of them might be willing to give up everything in order to save the innocent people of Elturel. When a good-aligned paladin or cleric of 10th level or higher performs such a selfless act, the power of that deed is eternally written upon their soul. To creatures that covet souls, this deed blazes like a bonfire in the darkness—and Zariel desires it. Such a character is likely destined to pass into the Upper Planes after death, and as such, they make a handsome prize for an archdevil to shape into a loyal servant of the Nine Hells.
data/8/entries/6/entries/5/entries/0.zh_tw: 如果角色們沒有其他處理扎瑞爾的選擇，他們中的一個或多個人可能願意放棄一切，以拯救艾爾托瑞爾的無辜人民。當一個善良陣營的聖武士或牧師，且等級在10級或以上，執行這樣一個無私的行為時，這一行為的力量將永恆地書寫在他們的靈魂上。對於那些渴望靈魂的生物來說，這一行為就像黑暗中的篝火一樣閃耀——扎瑞爾渴望得到它。這樣的角色很可能註定在死後進入上層界，因此，他們成為魔鬼大公塑造成九層地獄忠實僕人的絕佳獎品。
data/8/entries/6/entries/5/entries/0.reviewReason: 核對 archdevil 階級：魔鬼大公，非惡魔或泛稱強大魔鬼

data/8/entries/6/entries/5/entries/3.english: A character offering to sacrifice their soul can take advantage of this moment of uncertainty, making a Charisma ({@skill Persuasion}) check with advantage to sway Zariel from the path of evil. Resolve a successful check as noted in "{@area Redeeming Zariel|317|x}" earlier in this chapter. Even if the check fails, though, Zariel accepts the offered soul in exchange for all the souls of Elturel. Unless you want to add additional challenges for the characters, the archdevil can free the city from its chains and return it to the Material Plane.
data/8/entries/6/entries/5/entries/3.zh_tw: 一個角色提出犧牲自己的靈魂可以利用這個不確定的時刻，進行帶有優勢的魅力（{@skill Persuasion||說服}）檢定，以說服扎瑞爾放棄邪惡的道路。如本章前面"{@area 救贖扎瑞爾|317|x}"所述，解決成功的檢定。即使檢定失敗，扎瑞爾也會接受所提供的靈魂，以換取艾爾托瑞爾所有的靈魂。除非你想為角色增加額外的挑戰，否則魔鬼大公可以釋放這座城市的鏈條，將其返回物質界。
data/8/entries/6/entries/5/entries/3.reviewReason: 核對 archdevil 階級：魔鬼大公，非惡魔或泛稱強大魔鬼

data/8/entries/6/entries/5/entries/4/ent.english: If the characters try to bargain for Elturel's release without the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}, Zariel considers their offer and produces a contract stating that she will release the city in exchange for the sword, delivered without any complications or deceit. {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} rankles at the idea of the characters forging any sort of pact with the archdevil, but holds out hope that Zariel can be redeemed if the sword is brought before her.
data/8/entries/6/entries/5/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: 如果角色們試圖在沒有{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}的情況下為艾爾托瑞爾的釋放進行討價還價，扎瑞爾考慮了他們的提議，並出示了一份合同，宣告她將以劍作為交換釋放這座城市，且交付過程中不得有任何複雜情況或欺騙。{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}對角色們與魔鬼大公締結任何形式的契約感到憤怒，但仍抱有希望，認為如果寶劍呈現在扎瑞爾面前，她可以得到救贖。

data/8/entries/6/entries/5/entries/4/ent.english: Once destroyed, the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA} can't be restored, ending any hope of redemption for the archdevil.
data/8/entries/6/entries/5/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: 一旦被摧毀，{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}無法恢復，這終結了魔鬼大公得到救贖的所有希望。

data/8/entries/7/entries/4/entries/3.english: It is hard for insignificant mortals to gain the archdevil's attention, but if they anger Zariel, aid her in combat, or display {@creature Lulu|BGDIA} or the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}, she stops what she's doing and gives the characters a chance to speak to her—or to challenge her.
data/8/entries/7/entries/4/entries/3.zh_tw: 對於微不足道的凡人來說，要引起魔鬼大公的注意是很難的，但如果他們激怒了扎瑞爾，幫助她在戰鬥中，或者展示{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}或{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}，她會停下手頭的事情，給角色們一個與她交談——或者挑戰她的機會。

data/10/entries/4/entries/3.english: An archdevil who wishes to make a deal with a character can do so in person or send a minion to propose the deal and negotiate on its behalf. A character can also contact an archdevil by killing a chaotic- or good-aligned humanoid and praying to the archdevil over the course of 1 hour. The archdevil hears the character's prayer and can choose to respond in dreams or visions, or it can send a minion with the authority to make a deal on its behalf.
data/10/entries/4/entries/3.zh_tw: 一個想要與角色交易的魔鬼大公可以親自進行，或者派遣一個手下提出交易並代表它進行談判。角色也可以透過殺死一個混亂或善良陣營的類人生物，並在1小時的祈禱過程中向魔鬼大公祈禱來聯絡魔鬼大公。魔鬼大公會聽到角色的祈禱，並可以選擇在夢中或幻象中回應，或者它可以派遣一個有權力代表它進行交易的手下。

data/10/entries/6/entries/3/entries/0.english: Archdevils prize fealty almost as much as souls. One way in which a mortal can demonstrate fealty to an archdevil is to lead a religious cult devoted to the archdevil or perform heinous acts in the archdevil's name. A character can also enter into an agreement to serve the archdevil as a warlock. Such a character must take at least one level in the warlock class, choosing {@class Warlock||the Fiend|Fiend} (represented in this case by the archdevil) as their otherworldly patron.
data/10/entries/6/entries/3/entries/0.zh_tw: 魔鬼大公幾乎像珍視靈魂一樣珍視效忠。凡人可以領導崇拜某位魔鬼大公的教派，或以其名義犯下滔天惡行，藉此表明忠誠。角色也能締約，以契術師身分效忠魔鬼大公；這樣的角色必須至少取得一個契術師職業等級，並選擇{@class Warlock||邪魔|Fiend}作為異界宗主，此處的宗主就是那位魔鬼大公。

data/10/entries/9/entries/0.english: Charms are supernatural gifts described in {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Charms} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}. Archdevils and their appointed vassals can bestow such gifts on mortals, usually to entice them into signing an infernal contract. This section describes several new charms that archdevils and their vassals can bestow.
data/10/entries/9/entries/0.zh_tw: 護咒是{@book 第七章|DMG|7|Charms}中描述的超自然禮物（選自{@book 城主指南|DMG}）。魔鬼大公及其任命的附庸可以將這些禮物賦予凡人，通常是為了引誘他們簽署地獄契約。本節描述了魔鬼大公及其附庸可以賦予的幾種新護咒。
data/10/entries/9/entries/0.reviewReason: 核對易混語義：階級、護咒恩賜、魅惑效果與聖飛象種族

data/7/entries/6/entries/4/entries/7/ent.english: Once Zariel bestows her supernatural charms, {@creature Lulu|BGDIA}'s Idyllglen memory ends. A flash of light brings all the characters (including dead ones) back to the Bleeding Citadel so that one of them might finally claim the {@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA}.
data/7/entries/6/entries/4/entries/7/ent.zh_tw: 一旦扎瑞爾賦予她的超自然護咒，{@creature Lulu|BGDIA|露露}的伊迪爾格倫記憶就結束了。一道閃光將所有角色（包括死去的）帶迴流血城堡，以便其中一人最終可以認領{@item Sword of Zariel|BGDIA|扎瑞爾之劍}。
data/7/entries/6/entries/4/entries/7/ent.reviewReason: 核對易混語義：階級、護咒恩賜、魅惑效果與聖飛象種族

data/10/entries/4/entries/2.english: Lesser and greater devils can't freely make deals outside of their home plane, but there are ways it can be done. If a summoner on another plane knows a devil's true name or has its talisman (as described in "Devil True Names and Talismans" in the {@book Monster Manual|MM}), instead of binding the devil into service, the summoner can create a ritual circle that allows the devil to forge a deal. Once the deal is sealed with a contract, the devil returns to the Nine Hells.
data/10/entries/4/entries/2.zh_tw: 下級與上級魔鬼無法在其家園之外自由地締結契約，但有一些方法可以實現。如果另一個位面的召喚師知道一個魔鬼的真名或持有其護符（如{@book 怪物圖鑑|MM}中"魔鬼真名與護符"所述），召喚師可以建立一個儀式法陣，允許魔鬼締結契約，而不是將魔鬼束縛為僕從。一旦契約透過合同生效，魔鬼就會返回九層地獄。

data/1/entries/6/entries/7/entries/5/ent.zh_tw: 「只要你們照我的話做，我就會確保你們每人拿到兩百枚金幣，還有我的感激——後者可值錢多了。
data/1/entries/6/entries/7/entries/5/ent.reviewReason: 保留 NPC 原有傲慢語氣，不添加網路口頭禪；報酬兩百枚金幣

data/1/entries/12/entries/4/entries/4/en.english: You can use the optional loyalty rule in {@book chapter 4|DMG|4|Optional Rule: Loyalty} of the Dungeon Master's Guide to track the loyalty of a guide who isn't beholden to a secret master. Disloyal guides won't risk their lives to save player characters and might abandon the party entirely to preserve themselves. The guides described in this chapter have goals beyond helping the characters survive. Helping guides fulfill their personal goals increases their loyalty.
data/1/entries/12/entries/4/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 你可以使用《城主指南》{@book 第4章|DMG|4|Optional Rule: Loyalty}的忠誠度選用規則，追蹤未暗中效忠他人的嚮導之忠誠度。不忠誠的嚮導不會冒險拯救玩家角色，甚至可能為了自保而完全拋下隊伍。本章介紹的嚮導各有自身目標，並非只想協助角色生存。幫助嚮導達成個人目標，能提高他們的忠誠度。
data/1/entries/12/entries/4/entries/4/en.reviewReason: 依英文核對語境、數值與完整性

data/2/entries/4/entries/7/entries/6/ent.english: Templars from the Order of the Gauntlet removed everything of value from these tents when they came to inspect the scene of the disaster. A character who pokes around in one of these tents has a 1-in-6 chance of stirring up a {@creature poisonous snake}.
data/2/entries/4/entries/7/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 鐵手套教團的聖殿騎士前來勘查災難現場時，已帶走這些帳篷裡所有值錢的物品。角色在其中一頂帳篷裡翻找時，有六分之一的機率驚動一條{@creature poisonous snake}。
data/2/entries/4/entries/7/entries/6/ent.reviewReason: 依英文核對語境、數值與完整性

data/2/entries/4/entries/16/entries/0.english: The {@i Hvalspyd} (the name means "whale spear") is a longship sized for frost giants: 250 feet long, with sails made from white dragon wings. It's anchored 100 yards off a beach along Chult's northeast coast, 70 miles north of Kitcher's Inlet. It's impossible for the giants to hide the vessel; anyone sailing down the coast can't miss it.
data/2/entries/4/entries/16/entries/0.zh_tw: {@i 瓦爾斯皮德號}的名字意為「鯨魚之矛」，是一艘依霜巨人体型打造的長船：船長 250 尺，船帆以白龍的翅膀製成。它停泊在楚爾特東北海岸一處海灘外 100 碼，位於基徹灣以北 70 英里。巨人不可能藏起這艘船，任何沿岸航行的人都不會錯過它。
data/2/entries/4/entries/16/entries/0.reviewReason: 依英文核對語境、數值與完整性

data/2/entries/4/entries/40/entries/2/en.english: A {@creature giant snapping turtle|ToA} (see {@adventure appendix D|ToA|9}) of unusual size (120 hit points) likes to sun itself on the beaches during the day. Chultans refer to the beast as King Toba. Residual magic from the Spellplague has crystallized parts of its shell. The shell's magic grants King Toba advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
data/2/entries/4/entries/40/entries/2/en.zh_tw: 一隻體型異常的{@creature giant snapping turtle|ToA|巨鱷龜}（見{@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}），生命值為 120，喜歡在白天在海灘上曬太陽。楚爾坦人將這個怪獸稱為託巴王。來自魔法瘟疫的殘餘魔法使它的部分殼體結晶化。殼體的魔法賦予託巴王在對抗法術和其他魔法效果的豁免檢定上獲得優勢。

data/4/entries/4/entries/19/entries/1.english: When the characters arrive, twelve of the eighteen alcoves are occupied by six {@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||yuan-ti malisons} (two each of types 1, 2, and 3) and six {@creature Yuan-ti Pureblood||yuan-ti purebloods}. The remaining six alcoves are currently not in use. Passing through the area without being spotted is impossible unless the characters use magic to hide themselves.
data/4/entries/4/entries/19/entries/1.zh_tw: 當角色們到達時，十八個壁龕中有十二個被六隻{@creature Yuan-ti Malison (Type 1)||惡咒蛇人}（第 1、2、3 型各兩隻）和六隻{@creature Yuan-ti Pureblood||純血原體蛇人}佔據。剩下的六個壁龕目前沒有在使用中。除非角色們使用魔法來隱藏自己，否則不被察覺地穿過這個區域是不可能的。

data/5/entries/4/entries/1/rows/7/5.english: The host's Constitution score becomes 23, unless it is already higher.
data/5/entries/4/entries/1/rows/7/5.zh_tw: 宿主的體質值變為 23，除非其原有體質值更高。
data/5/entries/4/entries/1/rows/7/5.reviewReason: 修復能力欄誤填性格缺點

data/5/entries/6/entries/12/entries/8/en.english: {@creature Withers|ToA} is a diligent scribe. His moldy journals track the history of Omu and the Tomb of the Nine Gods, and detail the arrival of the atropal and the construction of the Soulmonger. Any character who spends 10 minutes flipping through the journals finds an entry that stands out. Give that character's player a copy of handout 22 in {@area appendix E|537|x}. To flesh out the journals further, refer to the "{@area History of Omu|1dc|x}" section in chapter 3 and "History of the Tomb" earlier in this chapter.
data/5/entries/6/entries/12/entries/8/en.zh_tw: {@creature Withers|ToA}是個勤奮的抄寫員。他發霉的日誌記錄了奧姆與九神之墓的歷史，也詳述神孽胚胎的到來和噬魂器的建造經過。任何花 10 分鐘翻閱日誌的角色，都會找到一則格外顯眼的紀錄。將{@area 附錄E|537|x}中的第 22 號講義交給該角色的玩家。若想進一步充實日誌內容，請參考第3章的「{@area 奧姆的歷史|1dc|x}」，以及本章前文的「墓穴的歷史」。
data/5/entries/6/entries/12/entries/8/en.reviewReason: 依英文核對語境、數值與完整性

data/7/entries/2/entries/5/entries/69/en.english: The characters stumble into a wondrous sight: a 120-foot-radius sphere of winter weather. To drive off some monsters, {@creature Artus Cimber|ToA} created the sphere using the {@item Ring of Winter|ToA}. All plants and surfaces within the sphere are covered with glittering ice and frost, and the temperature within the sphere is a biting −30 degrees Fahrenheit. The effect was created by an artifact and can't be dispelled.
data/7/entries/2/entries/5/entries/69/en.zh_tw: 角色們偶然發現了一幅奇景：一個半徑120尺的寒冬領域球體。為了驅趕某些怪物，{@creature Artus Cimber|ToA|阿圖斯·辛貝爾}使用{@item Ring of Winter|ToA|凜冬戒指}創造了這個球體。球體內所有植物和表面都覆蓋著閃亮的冰霜，內部溫度低至華氏 −30 度。該效果由一件神器創造，無法被驅散。
data/7/entries/2/entries/5/entries/69/en.reviewReason: 保留原文華氏溫度，不自行換算

data/2/entries/4/entries/47/entries/3/en.english: The voice calling to the party belongs to Thasselandra Bravewing, the ship's captain (NG female Halruaan human {@creature noble}). She explains the situation briefly before she weakens and her voice becomes too soft to hear from the ground. The other crash survivors include the ship's navigator, Ra-das (N male Halruaan human {@creature scout}); the master-of-arms, Falx Haranis (CN male Halruaan human {@creature veteran}); and three other crewmen named Brax, Nhar, and Veliod (N male Halruaan human {@creature Guard||guards}). Ra-das and Falx are in the stern section; the other NPCs are all in the midsection.
data/2/entries/4/entries/47/entries/3/en.zh_tw: 向隊伍呼喊的是船長薩瑟蘭德拉·勇翼，一位中立善良的哈魯阿人類女性{@creature noble}。她簡短說明狀況後便虛弱下來，聲音小得無法從地面聽清。其他墜船生還者包括領航員拉達斯（絕對中立的哈魯阿人類男性{@creature scout}）、軍械主管法爾克斯·哈拉尼斯（混亂中立的哈魯阿人類男性{@creature veteran}），以及布拉克斯、納爾、維利歐德三名船員（絕對中立的哈魯阿人類男性{@creature Guard||警衛}）。拉達斯與法爾克斯待在船尾部分，其餘 NPC 都在船身中段。
data/2/entries/4/entries/47/entries/3/en.reviewReason: master-of-arms 為船上職務；Halruaan 指人而非語言

data/1/entries/12/entries/5/entries/2/en.english: Deep in the heart of the jungle is a city built by minotaurs. It's now overrun by snake people, but even worse things dwell below. In visions, I have seen strange devils screaming in the dark.
data/1/entries/12/entries/5/entries/2/en.zh_tw: 在叢林的深處，有一座由牛頭人建造的城市。現在它被蛇人佔領了，但更糟糕的是，下面還棲息著其他生物。在幻象中，我看到了奇怪的魔鬼在黑暗中尖叫。
data/1/entries/12/entries/5/entries/2/en.reviewReason: 逐段核對 devil／archdevil 語境；保留魔鬼與惡魔的種族區別

data/3/entries/3/entries/2/entries/3/ent.english: A vine-draped gargoyle perches on the clifftop, staring down at the ruined city. It has the face of a devil, with its mouth agape in a silent scream.
data/3/entries/3/entries/2/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 一個被藤蔓覆蓋的石像鬼棲息在懸崖頂端，俯視著這座毀滅的城市。它有著魔鬼的面孔，嘴巴張開，無聲地尖叫。
data/3/entries/3/entries/2/entries/3/ent.reviewReason: 逐段核對 devil／archdevil 語境；保留魔鬼與惡魔的種族區別

data/5/entries/5/entries/3/entries/2/ent.english: Three stone gargoyles watch you from narrow ledges carved into the cliff side. Each has the face of a bearded devil, its mouth agape in a silent scream.
data/5/entries/5/entries/3/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 三個石像鬼從雕刻在懸崖邊上的狹窄壁架上注視著你。每個石像鬼都有一張須魔的臉，嘴巴張開，發出無聲的尖叫。
data/5/entries/5/entries/3/entries/2/ent.reviewReason: 逐段核對 devil／archdevil 語境；保留魔鬼與惡魔的種族區別

data/5/entries/5/entries/7/entries/0/ent.english: A moss-covered corridor extends beyond the second door. Tree roots hang from the sagging ceiling, and the air reeks of rot and damp. Ahead, a bas-relief carving of a bearded devil's face adorns the wall at a T-shaped intersection. The devil's open mouth is a well of utter darkness.
data/5/entries/5/entries/7/entries/0/ent.zh_tw: 一條覆蓋著苔蘚的走廊從第二扇門延伸出去。樹根從下垂的天花板上垂下，空氣中瀰漫著腐爛和潮溼的氣味。前方，在T字形的交叉口牆上，裝飾著一個須魔面孔的浮雕。魔鬼張開的嘴巴是一個完全黑暗的井。
data/5/entries/5/entries/7/entries/0/ent.reviewReason: 逐段核對 devil／archdevil 語境；保留魔鬼與惡魔的種族區別

data/5/entries/5/entries/7/entries/2/ent.english: Magical darkness and a permanent {@spell silence} spell fills the mouth of the devil face and a large cavity behind it. The face is sculpted from stone and melds seamlessly with the surrounding wall, and its mouth is wide enough for a Medium or smaller creature to crawl through. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals an aura of illusion magic over the face.
data/5/entries/5/entries/7/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 魔法黑暗和一個永久的{@spell silence||沉默術}法術充滿了魔鬼面孔的嘴巴以及其後的一個大型腔室。這張面孔是用石頭雕刻而成，與周圍牆壁無縫融合，它的嘴巴足夠寬敞，可以讓一箇中等大小或更小的生物爬過去。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果會揭示覆蓋在面孔上的幻術魔法氣息。
data/5/entries/5/entries/7/entries/2/ent.reviewReason: 逐段核對 devil／archdevil 語境；保留魔鬼與惡魔的種族區別

data/5/entries/5/entries/9/entries/2/ent.english: A hunched figure glares up at you from the balcony below, wearing a mask that is a replica of the devil face at the tomb entrance. Without saying a word, the figure steps out of sight.
data/5/entries/5/entries/9/entries/2/ent.zh_tw: 一個彎腰的身影從下面的陽臺上怒視著你，戴著一個與墓穴入口處的魔鬼面孔相同的面具。那個身影沒有說一句話，就走出了視線。
data/5/entries/5/entries/9/entries/2/ent.reviewReason: 逐段核對 devil／archdevil 語境；保留魔鬼與惡魔的種族區別

data/5/entries/5/entries/9/entries/3/ent.english: The clues on this plaque pertain to locations on level 2, specifically the gravity ring ({@area area 19|37d|x}), the false tomb ({@area area 20|383|x}), Nangnang's tomb ({@area area 24|398|x}), Papazotl's tomb ({@area area 22|38a|x}), and the devil pit ({@area area 18|37b|x}).
data/5/entries/5/entries/9/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 這塊牌匾上的線索與第二層的地點有關，具體是重力環（{@area 區域19|37d|x}），假墓（{@area 區域20|383|x}），娜浪的墓穴（{@area 區域24|398|x}），帕帕扎圖的墓穴（{@area 區域22|38a|x}），以及魔鬼坑（{@area 區域18|37b|x}）。

data/5/entries/6/entries/0.english: Map 5.2 shows this level of the dungeon. Mocking devil faces are graven into the walls, and the air reeks of rotting flesh. With no light to nourish it, the vegetation that fills much of level 1 doesn't extend down here.
data/5/entries/6/entries/0.zh_tw: 地圖5.2展示了地牢的這一層。牆上刻有嘲笑的魔鬼面孔，空氣中瀰漫著腐爛肉體的惡臭。由於沒有光線滋養，填滿第一層的植被並沒有延伸到這裡。

data/5/entries/6/entries/2/entries/0/ent.english: The walls and floor of this fifteen-foot-square room are cracked and carved with images of terrified humanoids falling. Set into the middle of the floor is a stone bas-relief of a bearded devil face, painted green. Forlorn cries echo from the black void of its gaping maw.
data/5/entries/6/entries/2/entries/0/ent.zh_tw: 這個十五尺見方的房間的牆壁和地板都裂開了，上面刻著驚恐的人形生物墜落的影象。房間中央鑲嵌著一個石制的浮雕，上面是一個須魔面孔，塗成了綠色。從它張開的大嘴裡傳來了絕望的哭聲。
data/5/entries/6/entries/2/entries/0/ent.reviewReason: 逐段核對 devil／archdevil 語境；保留魔鬼與惡魔的種族區別

data/5/entries/6/entries/2/entries/1.english: The devil face forms the mouth of a 5-foot-wide cylindrical shaft that descends 10 feet before opening up in the ceiling of {@area area 35|3d0|x}. Magical darkness fills the mouth and the shaft. A {@spell detect magic} spell or similar effect reveals auras of evocation and illusion magic within the shaft.
data/5/entries/6/entries/2/entries/1.zh_tw: 魔鬼面孔形成了一個5尺寬的圓柱形豎井的入口，豎井下降10尺後在{@area 區域35|3d0|x}的天花板上開口。魔法黑暗充滿了入口和豎井。一個{@spell detect magic||偵測魔法}法術或類似的效果揭示了豎井內部的塑能和幻術魔法的氣息。

Both the flaw and the power end when the spirit leaves the host.

data/5/entries/8/entries/10/entries/6/en.english: Queen Napaka has been dead for more than a century. If a {@spell speak with dead} spell is cast on her corpse, the characters can ask it questions about Omu and receive honest answers. Napaka came to believe that the gods of Omu were not truly divine beings but rather trickster spirits that had fooled the Omuan people into worshiping them. The queen remembers {@creature Acererak|ToA} killing the trickster gods and enslaving the Omuans, but she knows nothing about the Tomb of the Nine Gods, which was built after her death. She knows that a few members of the royal family fled Omu, but she is unaware that the aarakocra are sheltering her great-grandchildren at Kir Sabal. Napaka knows that her grandmother, Zalkoré, languishes in the ruins of Nangalore.
data/5/entries/8/entries/10/entries/6/en.zh_tw: 納帕卡女王已經去世一個多世紀了。如果在她的屍體上施放{@spell speak with dead||死者交談}法術，角色們可以向她詢問有關奧姆的問題並獲得誠實的答案。納帕卡開始相信奧姆的神並不是真正的神靈，而是由欺騙奧姆人民崇拜他們的詭神靈魂。女王記得{@creature Acererak|ToA|阿瑟瑞克}殺死了這些惡作劇的神靈並奴役了奧姆人，但她對九神之墓一無所知，因為它是在她死後建造的。她知道一些王室成員逃離了奧姆，但她不知道鳥羽人族正在基爾·薩巴爾庇護她的曾孫。納帕卡知道她的祖母，扎爾柯蕊，正在南加洛爾的廢墟中受苦。

data/4/entries/4/entries/20/entries/2.english: Issar is too stately to speak to the "meat" under his command. Instead, he's chosen a Chultan slave boy named Khoti to translate his subtle, unspoken gestures. A twitch of the tail could be interpreted as an order to fetch water, or the flick of the tongue an approval. In truth, Khoti makes up most of what he sees. Issar couldn't care less either way, as long as the correct amount of deference is shown. If strangers appear before Issar, Khoti questions them on his master's behalf.

data/0/entries/0/entries/0/entries/1.english: This adventure is much more than a deadly dungeon. To make it fun, we turned to Pendleton Ward, creator of the D&D-inspired animated series {@link Adventure Time|https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1305826}. Pen is a master storyteller who knows how to craft a meaningful narrative around humorous characters and trappings, and he understands that D&D players can create their own hilarity when given fun toys to play with. With Pen's help, we've tried to craft a tale filled with classic D&D tropes and odd twists that will make you and your players laugh, even as things are looking grim for the heroes. If the dancing monkey fruit doesn't do it for you, maybe the catapulting goblin village or the zombie-spewing undead tyrannosaurus will. There's also the tomb itself, which will hopefully illicit chuckles and screams of laughter with its murderous ingenuity.
data/0/entries/0/entries/0/entries/1.zh_tw: 這場冒險遠不只是一座致命地城。為了讓它充滿樂趣，我們找來彭德爾頓·沃德協助；他創作的動畫影集{@link 探險活寶|https://www.imdb.com/title/tt1305826}正是受到D&D啟發。彭是一位敘事大師，擅長以滑稽的角色與布景編織有意義的故事，也深知只要給D&D玩家有趣的玩具，他們自然會創造笑料。在彭的幫助下，我們試著寫出一個充滿經典D&D元素與古怪轉折的故事：即使英雄的處境十分險惡，你和玩家仍會笑出聲來。如果猴舞果還逗不笑你，也許能彈射出去的哥布林村落，或會吐出殭屍的不死暴龍就辦得到。當然還有墓穴本身；我們希望那些巧妙又致命的設計，能帶來竊笑、大笑與尖叫。

When a creature of the humanoid type touches such an item, the trickster god bound within attempts to inhabit that creature. With a successful {@dc 16} Charisma saving throw, the creature resists the god's power, and that god can't attempt to inhabit the same creature for the remainder of the adventure. On a failed save—or if the creature chooses to forgo the save—the god's spirit inhabits the creature's body. The trickster gods can tell whether or not a creature is humanoid, and they have no interest in possessing other types of creatures.
data/5/entries/4/entries/2/entries/0.zh_tw: 九位詭神的靈魂被束縛在散落墓中的魔法物品內。當類人生物類型的生物碰觸這些物品時，其中的詭神便會嘗試附身。該生物若通過{@dc 16}魅力豁免，便能抵抗神靈的力量；在本次冒險餘下的時間裡，這位詭神都無法再嘗試附身於同一生物。若豁免失敗，或該生物選擇放棄豁免，詭神的靈魂便進入其體內。詭神能辨別生物是否屬於類人生物，對附身於其他類型的生物沒有興趣。

data/5/entries/4/entries/3/entries/0.english: A trickster god never willingly leaves a host, but its spirit is forced out if a host dies or leaves the tomb, or if a host is targeted by the break enchantment function of the {@spell dispel evil and good} spell. A trickster god can also be forced out by another trickster god (see "Fighting Over a Host" below).
data/5/entries/4/entries/3/entries/0.zh_tw: 詭神絕不會自願離開宿主。不過，宿主死亡、離開墓穴，或受到{@spell dispel evil and good||驅逐善惡}法術「破除魔法」功能的作用時，神靈便會被迫離開。另一位詭神也能將其逐出宿主體內，詳見下方「爭奪宿主」。

data/5/entries/4/entries/3/entries/1.english: When the spirit of a trickster god is forced out of a host, it returns to the magic item to which it is bound and cannot inhabit that host again for the remainder of the adventure. If the item is destroyed or taken from the tomb, the trickster god's spirit finds another object within the tomb to inhabit. The spirits of the trickster gods can't be destroyed and can never leave the tomb.
data/5/entries/4/entries/3/entries/1.zh_tw: 被逐出宿主後，詭神的靈魂會回到束縛它的魔法物品中，且在本次冒險餘下的時間內都不能再附身於同一宿主。若該物品遭到摧毀或被帶離墓穴，詭神便會另找墓內的一件物品棲身。這些靈魂無法被摧毀，也永遠無法離開墓穴。

The host has no influence over which god gets forced out.

data/1/entries/8/entries/9/entries/4/ent.english: The chief priest of Waukeen in Port Nyanzaru is Sibonseni, Mother of Prosperity (LN female Chultan {@creature priest}). She is one of the city's most influential residents after the merchant princes, and she enjoys tremendous support from every layer of society for the temple's charitable work and for its support of civic improvements. In fact, the temple is also one of the city's richest banks. When Mother Sibonseni travels through the streets, she rides in an elegant sedan chair accompanied by drummers, singers, dancers, and temple aides who distribute fistfuls of copper coins to the poor. Needless to say, this causes traffic jams, but the people of the city love her.
data/1/entries/8/entries/9/entries/4/ent.zh_tw: 南扎路港的渥金主祭司是Siboneseni，繁榮之母（守序中立女性楚爾特 {@creature priest||祭司}）。她是城市中僅次於商王的最有影響力的居民之一，並且由於寺廟的慈善工作和對城市改進的支援，她享有社會各階層的巨大支援。實際上，寺廟也是城市中最富有的銀行之一。當繁榮之母Siboneseni穿過街道時，她乘坐在優雅的轎子中，由鼓手、歌手、舞者和寺廟助手陪同，他們向窮人分發一把把銅幣。不用說，這會引起交通堵塞，但城市裡的人們非常愛她。

data/2/entries/4/entries/12/entries/8.english: The main reason adventurers have for visiting Fort Beluarian is to buy a "charter of exploration." Baldur's Gate lays claim to everything east of the Mistcliff and north of Kitcher's Inlet, and now that Mezro is picked clean, it's trying to extend its claim south to Refuge Bay. No one (including the merchant princes of Port Nyanzaru) has the force in Chult to dispute this claim. So within its territory, the Flaming Fist does as it pleases, including demanding that explorers buy charters. A charter grants permission to the holder to explore Chult and plunder its riches, but half of an expedition's proceeds and discoveries must be turned over to the Flaming Fist. The charter costs 50 gp, which is treated as a down payment on the split of profits. In addition, those who buy a charter can hire up to six Flaming Fist mercenaries ({@creature Guard||guards}) to accompany them for the very reasonable rate of 1 gp per tenday each. It's easy enough to launch an expedition from Port Nyanzaru without a charter. The only risk is that if a Flaming Fist patrol runs into an expedition without a charter, it will attack the expedition and confiscate its gear.
data/2/entries/4/entries/12/entries/8.zh_tw: 冒險家們訪問貝路利安堡的主要原因是購買"探險許可證"。博德之門聲稱擁有迷霧崖以東和基徹爾灣以北的所有地區，並且由於梅茲羅已經被徹底搜刮一空，它現在正試圖將其主張擴展到南部的避難灣。沒有人（包括南扎路港的商王）在楚爾特擁有足夠的力量來爭議這一主張。因此，在它的領土內，焰拳為所欲為，包括要求探險家購買許可證。許可證授予持有人探索楚爾特並掠奪其財富的許可，但探險隊收益和發現的一半必須交給焰拳。許可證的費用是50金幣，被視為利潤分成的首付。此外，購買許可證的人可以以每旬每人1金幣的合理價格僱傭多達六名焰拳僱傭兵（{@creature Guard||警衛}）陪同他們。沒有許可證也可以很容易地從南扎路港發起探險隊。唯一的風險是，如果焰拳的巡邏隊遇到沒有許可證的探險隊，它將攻擊探險隊並沒收其裝備。

Whenever the characters come near a patch of the growth, it sprouts an eyestalk and attacks (see "{@area Alien Growth|3b2|x}").
data/5/entries/7/entries/18/entries/5/en.zh_tw: 貝爾科茲不會追趕逃離其金庫的入侵者。然而，如果冒險者從它的寶藏中偷走哪怕一枚銅幣，邪眼就會利用地牢這一層次的外星生長物來對付他們。每當角色們靠近一片生長物時，它就會長出一個眼柄並進行攻擊（見"{@area 外星生長物|3b2|x}"）。

They're just barely hanging on to another one. I see their emissaries all the time, heading up the River Soshenstar in canoes to get more supplies and templars from Port Nyanzaru.
data/1/entries/12/entries/5/entries/2/en.zh_tw: Gauntlet之序來到這裡是為了清除叢林中的不死生物。他們不久前失去了一個營地。他們勉強維持著另一個。我總是看到他們的使者，乘著獨木舟沿著索申斯塔河前往南扎路港獲取更多的補給和聖殿騎士。

Consequently, they pay no fees or fealty to any merchant prince; they keep their business quiet, meeting potential clients only in Malar's Throat or seedier houses in Tiryki Anchorage. They refer to one another as River and Flask.
data/1/entries/12/entries/4/entries/11/e.zh_tw: {@creature 河霧 Mist|ToA|河霧} 和 {@creature Flask of Wine|ToA|酒瓶}（CG 女性和男性 {@creature Tabaxi Hunter|ToA|斑貓獵人}；見 {@adventure 附錄D|ToA|9}）是一對手足，與散塔林會有聯絡。因此，他們不向任何商王支付費用或效忠；他們保持業務低調，只在 馬拉之喉 或 提爾基錨地 的陰暗房屋中與潛在客戶會面。他們互相稱呼對方為 河霧 和酒瓶。

(She lost her right eye in a childhood mishap involving a sling.) River is furtive and uncomfortable in crowds, preferring the jungle where she is truly at home.

data/3/entries/4/entries/17/entries/5/en.english: When a character enters this chamber, give the players a copy of handout 16 in {@adventure appendix E|ToA|10}. This grid is a puzzle key. If the letters from the riddle in area 16C are entered into the grid (minus spaces), the letters in the darkened squares spell out "cover eyes." This phrase provides a clue to obtaining the puzzle cube in area 16C.
data/3/entries/4/entries/17/entries/5/en.zh_tw: 角色進入這個房間時，將{@adventure 附錄E|ToA|10}的玩家講義16交給玩家。這個方格是解謎的關鍵：將區域16C謎詩的英文原文字母依序填入，略去空格，深色格子便會拼出「cover eyes」（遮住眼睛）。這句話提示了如何取得區域16C的謎題立方體。
data/3/entries/4/entries/17/entries/5/en.reviewReason: 字母格依原文拼字運作，明確保留英文輸入與答案

data/5/entries/6/entries/12/entries/9/en.english: {@creature Withers|ToA} has enough equipment on his desk to assemble a scholar's pack. A {@item manual of golems} (clay) lies open on his desk next to a spellbook containing all the spells he has prepared. On the inside back cover of the spellbook is what appears to be a name: Khomara Blackfire. "Khomara" and "Blackfire" are actually the command words for the {@item mirror of life trapping} in {@area area 50|44c|x}.
data/5/entries/6/entries/12/entries/9/en.zh_tw: {@creature Withers|ToA|威瑟斯}的桌上有足夠的裝備，可湊成一套學者套組。一本{@item manual of golems||魔像手冊}（黏土）攤在桌上，旁邊的法術書記載了他準備的所有法術。法術書封底內側寫著看似姓名的字樣：Khomara Blackfire。其實「Khomara」與「Blackfire」是{@area 區域50|44c|x}那面{@item mirror of life trapping||攝心鏡}的口令。
data/5/entries/6/entries/12/entries/9/en.reviewReason: 保留口令字面原文，確保線索與物品啟動方式相符

data/5/entries/8/entries/7/entries/4.english: The mirror has two command words. Speaking the word "Khomara" while standing within 5 feet of the mirror deactivates or reactivates it. (The mirror can't trap creatures while deactivated.) Speaking the word "Blackfire" along with a cell number frees the creature trapped in that cell.
data/5/entries/8/entries/7/entries/4.zh_tw: 鏡子有兩個口令。站在鏡子5尺內說出「Khomara」，便能關閉或重新啟動它；關閉時，鏡子無法困住生物。說出「Blackfire」並報出牢房編號，便能釋放該牢房中的生物。
data/5/entries/8/entries/7/entries/4.reviewReason: 保留英文口令與啟動距離，與法術書線索逐字一致

data/2/entries/4/entries/31/entries/6/en.english: The naga remembers {@creature Ras Nsi|ToA}'s first uprising, and she urges the characters to kill him both as punishment for his past atrocities and to prevent any possibility of a recurrence. Each character who agrees receives a supernatural charm (see {@book chapter 7|DMG|7|Charms} of the {@book Dungeon Master's Guide|DMG}) to aid their task. Assign charms to characters that are appropriate to their roles in the party. Characters who seem reluctant might have {@spell geas} cast on them.
data/2/entries/4/entries/31/entries/6/en.zh_tw: 納迦記得{@creature Ras Nsi|ToA|拉茲·納斯}的第一次起義，她敦促角色們殺死他，既是對他過去暴行的懲罰，也是為了防止任何復發的可能性。每個同意的角色都會收到一個超自然的護咒（見{@book 第七章|DMG|7|Charms}的{@book 城主指南|DMG}）。根據角色在隊伍中的角色分配適當的護咒。那些似乎猶豫不決的角色可能會被施加{@spell geas||指使術}法術。
data/2/entries/4/entries/31/entries/6/en.reviewReason: 核對易混語義：階級、護咒恩賜、魅惑效果與聖飛象種族
